title: Decision paths — three coherent ways forward, each with the gate that blocks its first step and the number that clears it
how_to_use: pick ONE path (paths differ on provenance and money, not on quality of code), then work its steps in order. A step may not start until its gate is cleared by its number. Nothing here is implemented by this namespace.

rows.name: Official-only, price-free (no licence, no third-party numbers)
rows.what_it_is: Publish model probabilities, availability indices and a skill-only leaderboard computed from league pages and from game books used as internal labels. No residual column, no CLV, no ROI, no paid rewards.
rows.first_step: Stand up the collector (CD-04 A) so availability becomes a dated series.
rows.gate: Two or more dated captures per game week exist for 4 consecutive weeks.
rows.clearing_number: ≥ 8 captures in a 4-week window, each with a hash, 0 missing required fields, drift alarm silent
then: CD-03 A terms note → game-book label table for every fixture reachable
CD-06 unit + gate definition → corpus page rebuilt from the standings identity
CD-07 join → designation play rate with Wilson intervals and n
CD-10/CD-14 skill division of the leaderboard, provisional flag until the window closes
rows.forbids: any 'market' word in a title; any correlation value computed from a non-official number; any payout
rows.earliest_leaderboard: a provisional skill division as soon as 148 fixtures are graded — i.e. today's corpus already exceeds a 100-fixture floor if the owner lowers the gate
rows.risk: the site can never answer 'is our line better than the market's', which is the question the origination programme exists to answer

rows.name: Official + licensed prices (the full programme)
rows.what_it_is: Everything in PATH-A plus the price-snapshot store, fair/market/difference columns, residual published on a schedule, CLV escrow, two-stage leaderboard and rewards.
rows.first_step: Answer CD-02 with option A and name the vendor; store its terms in git with a hash.
rows.gate: A licence exists and the vendor's history is downloadable at the granularity the snapshot store needs (open + close per market per game).
rows.clearing_number: ≥ 1 season of closing lines downloadable before the first residual is published, and the ingest must reproduce the archive's own row count within 0 variance
then: snapshot store with opening/closing numbers per market
residual column appears on the origination page
two-stage leaderboard: proper-score qualification then prospective CLV escrow
rewards denominated in the escrow, never in the backtest
rows.forbids: paying on any window shorter than the registered prospective window; mixing vendor and scraped prices in one column
rows.cost: money + a collector + a terms review
rows.earliest_leaderboard: the season after the archive starts, because CLV must be prospective
rows.risk: a dependency that can be killed by a budget line; every downstream claim inherits the vendor's provenance

rows.name: Official + third-party archive, labelled on every row (no money)
rows.what_it_is: PATH-A, plus research-grade residuals computed from a third-party price archive that is visibly not official, kept out of the public tables' titles.
rows.first_step: Answer CD-02 with option C and write the labelling rule into the publication contract: every row carrying a third-party number carries the label in the same row.
rows.gate: The verifier enforces the label: a price-bearing row without a provenance label fails the build.
rows.clearing_number: 100 % of rows with a non-official number carry a provenance field; a CI test that fails on 0 rows missing it
then: same sequence as PATH-A, with residuals added as an internal grade only
promote a residual to the public site only if the owner later relaxes the rule
rows.forbids: the word 'market' in a public title; a reward paid on third-party numbers; silence about provenance
rows.earliest_leaderboard: as PATH-A, plus an internal residual track
rows.risk: a reader cannot tell which numbers the league published and which it did not — the label is the only defence, so the enforcement has to be a build failure, not a note

sources.label: this namespace's own verifier, which is the enforcement mechanism proposed
